docs.title: Demo queries
docs.text: How long is this waveform? Which DUT blocks were dumped? What was the timer value at 66 ns? What is the timer clock period? Did the TAP controller FSM toggle? Were there any resets between 610 and 660 ns? When did MSCRATCH first equal f7ff8818? How many AXI DMEM reads occurred during the simulation? When did AXI DMEM reads target address 0x87e? Which AXI DMEM writes started in this range? What AXI DMEM traffic occurred in this range?
